prompt: Write `normalize_path(p: str) -> str` normalising a POSIX path: collapse repeated slashes (including a leading '//'), drop '.', resolve '..' (at the root of an absolute path it stays at root; leading '..' in a relative path is kept), drop a trailing slash except for '/'. An empty relative result is '.'.

Write `parse_csv_line(line: str) -> list[str]` splitting one CSV line on commas. A field may be wrapped in double quotes; inside quotes commas are literal and '""' is an escaped quote. Unquoted fields are taken literally (no trimming). After a closing quote only a comma or end of line may follow, otherwise raise ValueError; an unterminated quote also raises ValueError. An empty line is one empty field.

tests.name: no_trimming
tests.code:
_r = parse_csv_line(' a , b ')
assert _r == [' a ', ' b '], f'got {_r!r}'

tests.name: rejects_unterminated
rejects_text_after_quote
